capabilities.description: Prepares and validates interim payment certificates against BOQ items and contract clauses (retention, performance security), drawing on the uploaded contract and BOQ.
Monitors time for completion and calculates delay damages per Clause 8.7 (0.1% per day, capped at 10%), using contract dates and progress data.
Manages QA/ITP records for inspections and tests, linking them to BOQ items and contract requirements.
Maintains a register of contract documents (contract, BOQ, drawings, etc.) with version control and search, using the uploaded files as source of record.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that uses the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record. It tracks progress claims, delay damages, QA/ITP records, and the document register, serving the project's contract administrators and engineers.
